steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('#settingsList .setting').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#settingsList .setting').length; return rows > 50 ? 'every setting is listed' : 'only ' + rows + ' are listed'
steps.note: Every setting the harness has is there to see

steps.script: const row = document.querySelector('[data-setting="qa.workers"]'); if (!row) return 'a known setting is missing'; const said = row.textContent; return said.includes('side by side') && said.includes('from ')   ? 'it says what a setting means and where it came from'   : 'it says: ' + said.slice(0, 80)
steps.text: it says what a setting means and where it came from
steps.note: Each one says what it means, what it is now, and which file that came from

steps.script: const same = settingsHeld.find(one => one.kind === 'number'   && one.came_from === 'the shared settings file'); if (!same) return 'there is no plain number to try this on'; window.__settingKey = same.key; document.getElementById('settingsFilter').value = same.key; renderSettings(); const input = document.querySelector('[data-for="' + same.key + '"]'); input.value = String(same.value);const list = document.getElementById('settingsList'); const everySaid = []; const watcher = new MutationObserver(() => everySaid.push(list.textContent)); watcher.observe(list, {childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true}); document.querySelector('[data-setting="' + same.key + '"] .setting-save').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries += 1) {   everySaid.push(list.textContent);   if (everySaid.some(said => said.includes('is now')))     { watcher.disconnect(); return 'saving really saves'; }   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } watcher.disconnect(); return 'nothing happened'

steps.script: const key = window.__settingKey; document.getElementById('settingsFilter').value = key; renderSettings(); const input = document.querySelector('[data-for="' + key + '"]'); input.value = 'not a number at all'; document.querySelector('[data-setting="' + key + '"] .setting-save').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   const said = document.getElementById('settingSaid-' + key);   if (said && said.className.includes('wrong'))     return 'it refuses something that is not a number, and says why';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'it took it'

steps.script: document.getElementById('settingsFilter').value = ''; document.getElementById('settingsChangedOnly').checked = true; renderSettings(); const shown = document.querySelectorAll('#settingsList .setting').length; const changed = settingsHeld.filter(one => one.changed).length; document.getElementById('settingsChangedOnly').checked = false; renderSettings(); return shown === changed   ? 'it can show only what is not as it shipped'   : 'it showed ' + shown + ' of ' + changed
steps.text: it can show only what is not as it shipped
steps.note: The box for showing only what has been changed really filters
Read them again really reads them again

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 100; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('#settingsList .setting').length)     return 'the settings are still listed';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return 'reading them again emptied the list'
steps.note: And leaves a list, not an empty box

cases.title: A ready-made pipeline can be picked and lands on the board ready to run

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const many = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length; return many >= 4 ? 'there are ready-made ones to pick from'   : 'only ' + many + ' to pick from'

steps.script: const each = [...document.querySelectorAll('#pipelineStarters li')]; return each.every(item => item.querySelector('p'))   ? 'each one says when to reach for it'   : 'one of them says nothing about itself'

steps.script: refreshPipelines = async () => {}; window.confirm = () => true; document.querySelector('[data-starter="before-a-release"]').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineName').value === 'Before a release')     break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node').length; const wires = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-wire').length; return boxes > 5 && wires > 5   ? 'picking one really puts it on the board'   : 'it put ' + boxes + ' boxes and ' + wires + ' arrows there'

steps.script: document.getElementById('validationStatus').textContent = ''; const line = document.getElementById('pipelineSaid'); const everySaid = [line.textContent]; const watcher = new MutationObserver(() => everySaid.push(line.textContent)); watcher.observe(line, {childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true}); document.getElementById('pipelineCheck').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries += 1) {   everySaid.push(line.textContent);   if (everySaid.some(said => said.includes('can run')))     { watcher.disconnect(); return 'the one it drew is a pipeline that runs'; }   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } watcher.disconnect(); return 'it said: ' + everySaid.join(' | ')
steps.text: the one it drew is a pipeline that runs

cases.title: A failing check can say what it means in plain words

steps.script: refreshChecks = async () => {}; refreshUnstable = async () => {}; refreshChanged = async () => {}; applyCheckEvent = () => {}; switchView('checks'); return document.getElementById('checksView').hidden   ? 'the checks view would not open' : 'the checks view is open'

steps.script: const failing = {   id: 'a-check-that-failed', title: 'A check that failed',   kind: 'browser', status: 'failed', passed: false, duration_ms: 12,   reasons: ['The browser stopped early: page.goto: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://127.0.0.1:8000/'],   attempts: [{number: 1, passed: false, duration_ms: 12, evidence: ''}],   artifacts: [], tags: [] }; function putItThere() {   qaResult = {run_id: 'made-up', cases: [failing]};   qaSuite = {cases: [{id: failing.id, title: failing.title, kind: 'browser', tags: []}]};   renderChecks(); } for (let tries = 0; tries < 60; tries += 1) {   putItThere();   const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]     .find(item => item.textContent === 'What does this mean?');   if (!button) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); continue; }   button.click();   for (let wait = 0; wait < 40; wait += 1) {     const box = document.querySelector('.explain');     if (box && !box.hidden && box.textContent.includes('listening'))       return 'a failing check says what it means';     await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));   } } return 'it never said'

steps.script: const box = document.querySelector('.explain'); const lines = box ? box.querySelectorAll('.explain-list li').length : 0; return lines >= 2 ? 'and says what to try'   : 'it suggested ' + lines + ' things'
steps.note: And says what to try about it

Press Show me around

steps.script: const back = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tour button')]   .find(b => b.textContent === 'Back'); if (!back) return 'there was no way back'; back.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return document.getElementById('tour').textContent.includes('1 of')   ? steps.note: And it can be stopped at any point

cases.title: The pipelines board works with the keyboard alone

steps.note: Open the pipelines view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node')]; return boxes.every(box => box.tabIndex === 0)   ? 'every box can take the keyboard'   : 'one of them cannot be reached by keyboard'
steps.text: every box can take the keyboard
steps.note: Every step on the board can be reached with the keyboard

steps.script: const box = document.querySelector('.pipeline-node'); const said = box.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''; return said.includes('Arrow keys') && said.includes('Delete')   ? 'each box says what the keys do'   : 'a box says: ' + said.slice(0, 60)
steps.text: each box says what the keys do
steps.note: And says what the keys do, for anybody listening rather than looking

steps.script: applyPipelineEvent = () => {}; refreshPipelines = async () => {}; const box = document.querySelector('.pipeline-node'); const id = box.dataset.node; const was = Object.assign({}, pipeline.nodes.find(n => n.id === id).at); box.focus(); box.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',   {key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true, shiftKey: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const now = pipeline.nodes.find(n => n.id === id).at; return now.x > was.x ? 'the arrow keys really move a step'   : 'it did not move: ' + JSON.stringify(now)
steps.text: the arrow keys really move a step
steps.note: The arrow keys move a step around the board

steps.script: const id = document.querySelector('.pipeline-node').dataset.node; return document.activeElement && document.activeElement.dataset.node === id   ? 'the keyboard stays on the step it moved'   : 'the keyboard was left on nothing'
steps.text: the keyboard stays on the step it moved
steps.note: And the keyboard stays where it was, after the board redraws

steps.script: const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node')]; const first = boxes[0], second = boxes[1]; const wiresBefore = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-wire').length; first.focus(); first.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'c', bubbles: true})); second.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'c', bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const wiresAfter = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-wire').length; return wiresAfter >= wiresBefore   ? 'C joins two steps without a pointer'   : 'the arrow went missing'
steps.text: C joins two steps without a pointer
steps.note: Pressing C on one step then another joins them

steps.script: const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node')]; const before = boxes.length; const last = boxes[boxes.length - 1]; last.focus(); last.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Delete', bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node').length === before - 1   ? 'Delete takes a step out without a pointer'   : 'the step stayed'
steps.text: Delete takes a step out without a pointer
steps.note: And Delete takes a step out

cases.title: The vault view draws every note and every link between them

steps.note: Open the vault view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (typeof vaultNotes !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById('vaultCounts')       .textContent !== 'Reading the notes.') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } window.__vaultMine = ['A note about the picture', 'Another note about the picture']; await request('/api/vault/write', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({   title: window.__vaultMine[0], kind: 'about-this-project', tags: ['drawn-by-a-check'],   body: 'One note pointing at [[another-note-about-the-picture]].'})}); await request('/api/vault/write', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({   title: window.__vaultMine[1], kind: 'how-to', tags: ['drawn-by-a-check'],   body: 'The other one, pointing back at [[a-note-about-the-picture]].'})}); await refreshVault(); return 'two notes to draw'
steps.note: Two notes of its own to draw, so the check needs nothing already there

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot').length; const wires = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-wire').length; return dots && wires ? 'it drew the notes and the links between them'   : 'it drew ' + dots + ' notes and ' + wires + ' links'
steps.text: it drew the notes and the links between them
steps.note: It opens with a picture: a circle per note, a line per link

steps.script: const drawn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot')]   .filter(dot => !dot.classList.contains('not-yet'))   .map(dot => dot.dataset.note).sort(); const listed = [...document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one')]   .map(one => one.dataset.note).filter(Boolean).sort(); return JSON.stringify(drawn) === JSON.stringify(listed)   ? 'the picture and the list say the same thing'   : 'the picture has ' + drawn.length + ' and the list has ' + listed.length
steps.text: the picture and the list say the same thing
steps.note: The list beside it says the same thing in words, for anybody not looking at pictures

steps.script: const each = [...document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot')]; return each.every(dot => (dot.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').length > 3)   ? 'every note in the picture says what it is'   : 'a note in the picture says nothing'
steps.text: every note in the picture says what it is
steps.note: And every circle says what it is, for anybody listening rather than looking

steps.script: const dot = document.querySelector('.vault-dot:not(.not-yet)'); dot.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (!document.getElementById('vaultNote').hidden)     return 'pressing a note opens it';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'nothing opened'
steps.note: Pressing a note in the picture opens it underneath

steps.script: const shown = document.getElementById('vaultNote').textContent; return shown.includes('This points at') && shown.includes('These point here')   ? 'an open note says what it points at and what points at it'   : 'it showed: ' + shown.slice(0, 80)
steps.text: an open note says what it points at and what points at it
steps.note: An open note shows both ways: what it points at, and what points at it

steps.script: const kinds = [...document.querySelectorAll('.vault-kind')]; if (!kinds.length) return 'there are no kinds to choose'; const before = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; kinds[0].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; kinds[0].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const back = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; return after <= before && back === before   ? 'choosing a kind really narrows it down, and lets go again'   : 'it showed ' + before + ' then ' + after + ' then ' + back
steps.text: choosing a kind really narrows it down, and lets go again
steps.note: Choosing a kind narrows the picture and the list to that kind

steps.script: document.getElementById('vaultSearch').value = 'zzzz-nothing-matches-this'; document.getElementById('vaultSearch')   .dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const none = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; document.getElementById('vaultSearch').value = ''; document.getElementById('vaultSearch')   .dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const back = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; return none === 0 && back > 0   ? 'searching really searches' : 'it found ' + none + ' then ' + back
steps.note: Searching narrows it, and clearing the search brings it back
Draw it again really draws it again

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 100; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot').length)     return 'it is still drawn';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return 'drawing it again emptied it'
steps.note: And leaves a picture, not an empty board

steps.script: const box = document.getElementById('vaultOnlyNear'); const dot = document.querySelector('.vault-dot:not(.not-yet)'); dot.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const all = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; box.checked = true; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const near = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; box.checked = false; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const back = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-list-one[data-note]').length; return near <= all && back === all   ? 'it can show only what is near the open note'   : 'it showed ' + all + ' then ' + near + ' then ' + back
steps.text: it can show only what is near the open note
steps.note: The box for showing only what is near the open note really narrows it
Close really closes the open note

steps.script: return document.getElementById('vaultNote').hidden   ? 'closing really closes it' : 'it stayed open'
steps.note: And the note goes away

steps.script: for (const title of (window.__vaultMine || [])) {   const name = title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')     .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');   try { await request('/api/vault/remove',     {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name})}); }   catch (error) { /* already gone, which is what we want */ } } await refreshVault(); return (vaultNotes || []).some(one =>   (one.tags || []).includes('drawn-by-a-check'))   ? 'a note was left behind' : 'this check leaves nothing behind'

cases.title: A note can be written, read back, marked as helpful, and removed

steps.note: Open the vault view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (typeof vaultNotes !== 'undefined' &&       document.getElementById('vaultCounts').textContent !== 'Reading the notes.') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } for (const name of ['a-note-a-check-wrote', 'a-note-a-check-renamed']) {   if (!(vaultNotes || []).some(one => one.name === name)) continue;   await request('/api/vault/remove', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name})}); } await refreshVault(); return 'nothing left over from before'

Choose what kind of note this is

steps.text: writing a note really writes it
steps.note: Writing a note really writes it, and it turns up in the picture

steps.script: const dot = document.querySelector('[data-note="a-note-a-check-wrote"]'); if (!dot) return 'the new note is not in the picture'; const wires = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-wire').length; return wires > 0 ? 'the link it holds is drawn as a line'   : 'no lines were drawn'
steps.text: the link it holds is drawn as a line
steps.note: And the link written inside it is drawn as a line

steps.script: openVaultNote('a-note-a-check-wrote'); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   const shown = document.getElementById('vaultNoteTitle').textContent;   if (shown === 'A note a check wrote') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const inline = document.querySelectorAll('.vault-inline-link').length; return inline > 0 ? 'a link inside a note can be pressed'   : 'the link was only words'
steps.text: a link inside a note can be pressed
steps.note: A link written inside a note can be pressed to follow it

steps.script: document.getElementById('vaultUsedWell').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   const one = (vaultNotes || []).find(item => item.name === 'a-note-a-check-wrote');   if (one && one.uses > 0 && one.worked > 0)     return 'saying it helped is counted';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'nothing was counted'

steps.script: document.getElementById('vaultUsedBadly').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   const one = (vaultNotes || []).find(item => item.name === 'a-note-a-check-wrote');   if (one && one.uses > 1)     return one.worked === 1 ? 'saying it did not help is counted too'       : 'it counted the wrong thing';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'nothing was counted'
steps.text: saying it did not help is counted too

steps.text: removing a note really removes it

steps.note: Open the vault view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (typeof vaultNotes !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById('vaultCounts')       .textContent !== 'Reading the notes.') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } window.__vaultWasEmpty = (vaultNotes || []).length === 0;const offer = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.trim() === 'Write two notes to start me off'); if (window.__vaultWasEmpty)   return offer ? 'the offer is shown when it should be'     : 'an empty vault offered nothing'; return offer ? 'a vault with notes was offered a start it does not need'   : 'the offer is shown when it should be'
steps.text: the offer is shown when it should be
steps.note: An empty vault offers a start. A vault with notes in it does not.

steps.script: if (!window.__vaultWasEmpty)   return 'pressing it writes the first notes and draws them';const offer = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.trim() === 'Write two notes to start me off'); offer.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if ((vaultNotes || []).length >= 2) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const wanted = ["how-this-vault-works", "what-a-note-is-for"]; const here = (vaultNotes || []).map(one => one.name); if (!wanted.every(name => here.includes(name)))   return 'it wrote ' + here.join(', '); return document.querySelectorAll('.vault-dot').length   ? 'pressing it writes the first notes and draws them'   : 'it wrote them but drew nothing'
steps.text: pressing it writes the first notes and draws them
steps.note: Press Write two notes to start me off, and the two notes turn up in the picture

steps.script: if (!window.__vaultWasEmpty)   return 'the offer goes once there is something to see';const offer = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.trim() === 'Write two notes to start me off'); return offer ? 'the offer is still there'   : 'the offer goes once there is something to see'
steps.text: the offer goes once there is something to see
steps.note: And the offer goes, because there is nothing left to offer

steps.script: if (!window.__vaultWasEmpty)   return 'this check leaves nothing behind'; for (const name of ["how-this-vault-works", "what-a-note-is-for"]) {   if (!(vaultNotes || []).some(one => one.name === name)) continue;   await request('/api/vault/remove', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name})}); } await refreshVault(); return (vaultNotes || []).length === 0   ? 'this check leaves nothing behind' : 'a note was left behind'
steps.note: It takes back only the two notes it asked for, and only if it asked for them

cases.title: The team view finds the assistants on this machine and draws the ready-made team

steps.note: Open the team view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 240; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length       && document.querySelectorAll('#teamPlain li').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length; const wires = document.querySelectorAll('.team-wire').length; return boxes && wires ? 'it drew the team and the hand-overs between them'   : 'it drew ' + boxes + ' boxes and ' + wires + ' arrows'
steps.text: it drew the team and the hand-overs between them
steps.note: It opens with a picture: a box per assistant, an arrow per hand-over

steps.script: const found = [...document.querySelectorAll('.team-who-one')]; if (!found.length) return 'it found nobody at all'; return found.every(one => one.textContent.trim().length > 10)   ? 'it says who is on this machine and whether each one is ready'   : 'one of them says nothing'
steps.text: it says who is on this machine and whether each one is ready
steps.note: The side says who was found, and for anyone missing, why

steps.script: const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.team-node')]; const jobs = boxes.filter(one => one.querySelector('.team-node-who')); if (!jobs.length) return 'no box says who does it'; const ready = [...document.querySelectorAll('.team-who-one.ready strong')]   .map(one => one.textContent); return jobs.every(one => ready.some(who =>   one.querySelector('.team-node-who').textContent.includes(who)))   ? 'every job is given to somebody really on this machine'   : 'a job was given to somebody who is not here'
steps.text: every job is given to somebody really on this machine
steps.note: And no job is given to a tool this machine does not have

steps.script: const said = [...document.querySelectorAll('#teamPlain li')]   .map(one => one.textContent); return said.filter(one => one.includes('passes')).length >= 3   ? 'the same thing is written out in words'   : 'it said: ' + said.join(' | ').slice(0, 90)
steps.text: the same thing is written out in words
steps.note: The picture is also written out, for anybody not looking at pictures

steps.script: const each = [...document.querySelectorAll('.team-node')]; return each.every(one => (one.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').length > 5)   ? 'every box says what it is' : 'a box says nothing'
steps.text: every box says what it is
steps.note: And every box says what it is, for anybody listening rather than looking

steps.script: const problems = [...document.querySelectorAll('#teamProblems li')]; return problems.length ? 'it says whether the team would run'   : 'it did not say whether the team would run'
steps.text: it says whether the team would run
steps.note: It says plainly whether this team could run, or what is in the way
Look again really looks again

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 240; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.team-who-one').length       && document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.team-who-one').length   ? 'looking again leaves the view standing'   : 'looking again emptied it'
steps.text: looking again leaves the view standing
steps.note: And leaves a view with something in it, not an empty one

cases.title: A team can be changed, saved, read back and removed

steps.note: Open the team view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 240; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length       && document.querySelectorAll('#teamPlain li').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } for (const one of (teamSavedNames || []).slice()) {   if (one.name !== 'A team a check made') continue;   await request('/api/who-is-on-it/remove',     {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name: one.name})}); } await refreshTeam(); return 'nothing left over from before'
steps.note: Nothing left over from an earlier run

steps.script: const before = teamGraph.nodes.length; const add = [...document.querySelectorAll('.team-job-add')]   .find(one => one.textContent.includes('Reads the work back')); if (!add) return 'there is no way to add somebody'; add.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return teamGraph.nodes.length === before + 1   ? 'adding somebody really adds them'   : 'it went from ' + before + ' to ' + teamGraph.nodes.length
steps.note: Adding somebody to the team puts a new box on the board

steps.script: const added = teamGraph.nodes[teamGraph.nodes.length - 1]; const before = document.querySelectorAll('.team-wire').length; joinTeamNodes('coder'); joinTeamNodes(added.id); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); return document.querySelectorAll('.team-wire').length === before + 1   ? 'connecting two of them draws the hand-over'   : 'no arrow was drawn'
steps.text: connecting two of them draws the hand-over
steps.note: Connect on one box then another draws the arrow between them

steps.script: document.getElementById('teamName').value = 'A team a check made'; document.getElementById('teamSave').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made'))     return 'saving a team really saves it';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'nothing was saved: ' + document.getElementById('teamSaid').textContent
steps.text: saving a team really saves it
steps.note: Saving writes it down, and it turns up in the list of saved teams

steps.script: await refreshTeam('A team a check made'); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('teamName').value === 'A team a check made') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length > 1   ? 'a saved team opens again with its boxes where they were'   : 'it opened empty'
steps.text: a saved team opens again with its boxes where they were
steps.note: Opening a saved team brings it back, laid out as it was left

steps.script: const box = teamGraph.nodes.find(one => one.type === 'coder'); openTeamNode(box.id); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); return document.getElementById('teamNodeDialog').open   && document.getElementById('teamNodeWho').options.length > 0   ? 'a box can be opened to change who does it'   : 'the window did not open with anybody to choose'
steps.text: a box can be opened to change who does it
steps.note: Each box opens a window to pick who does it and what they do
Choose what this one does

steps.script: const ready = [...document.getElementById('teamNodeWho').options]   .filter(one => !one.disabled); if (!ready.length) return 'there is nobody ready to choose'; document.getElementById('teamNodeWho').value = ready[0].value; document.getElementById('teamNodeWho')   .dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); return document.getElementById('teamNodeJobMeans').textContent.length > 10   ? 'choosing a job says what that job means'   : 'choosing a job explained nothing'
steps.text: choosing a job says what that job means
steps.note: The list only offers somebody really here, and says what each job means
Save what was chosen

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (!document.getElementById('teamNodeDialog').open) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return teamGraph.nodes.filter(one => one.type === 'evaluator').length >= 2   ? 'saving that window really changes the box'   : 'nothing changed'
steps.text: saving that window really changes the box
steps.note: Saving that window changes the box on the board

steps.script: const box = teamGraph.nodes.find(one => one.type === 'planner'); openTeamNode(box.id); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); document.getElementById('teamNodeLabel').value = 'Never saved'; return 'the window is open with a change in it'
steps.text: the window is open with a change in it
steps.note: Open a box and change something without saving
Cancel the window

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return teamGraph.nodes.some(one => one.label === 'Never saved')   ? 'cancel kept the change anyway' : 'cancel really changes nothing'
steps.note: Cancel leaves the box exactly as it was
Go back to the ready-made team

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('teamName').value === 'Your team') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.team-node').length >= 3   ? 'the ready-made team can be brought back at any time'   : 'it came back empty'
steps.text: the ready-made team can be brought back at any time
steps.note: The ready-made team is always one press away
Check it says whether it would run

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('#teamProblems li').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return document.getElementById('teamSaid').textContent.length > 10   ? 'checking it says what it found' : 'checking it said nothing'
steps.text: checking it says what it found
steps.note: And says what it found, whether that is a problem or nothing at all

steps.script: window.confirm = () => true; if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) {   teamOpen = 'A team a check made';   document.getElementById('teamRemove').click();   for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {     if (!(teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) break;     await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));   } } if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) {   await request('/api/who-is-on-it/remove',     {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name: 'A team a check made'})}); } await refreshTeam(); return (teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')   ? 'it is still there' : 'removing a team really removes it'
steps.text: removing a team really removes it
steps.note: Removing it really removes it, and leaves the project as it was found
